snippet.title: DATA BREACH - Official Release Trailer
snippet.description:
DATA BREACH launches July 21: corporate horror for 1-4 expendable robots. Steal the data, catch the train, do not get left behind. Play the demo now, then wishlist the full game and bring your crew for launch!

Play the demo and wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3724820/DATA_BREACH/

Join the community on Discord: https://discord.gg/99pBsx9jv6
Music by: https://www.instagram.com/matthew_johnson.music/?hl=en
